test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ________ purpose of the coaching was to identify the talented players.
solution:
The correct answer is** "main".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Main"** means primary or most important.(प्राथमिक या सबसे महत्वपूर्ण.)
 
• The sentence is referring to the **main purpose of the coaching,** which is to identify talented players.
 
• **"Mean"** means to intend or signify.(इरादा या संकेत करना।)
 
• **"Mine"** refers to a place where minerals are extracted.(वह स्थान जहाँ खनिज निकाले जाते हैं)
 
• **"Mane"** is the long hair on the neck of a horse or lion.(घोड़े या शेर की गर्दन पर लंबे बाल।)

Therefore, the correct answer is** "option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1,** "mean", **does not fit the context of the sentence as it does not refer to the purpose of the coaching.
 
• Option 2**, "mine",** is not relevant to the sentence as it refers to a place where minerals are extracted.
 
• Option 3, **"mane",** is also not applicable as it refers to the hair on the neck of a horse or lion.

165:T9c5,

The correct answer is** "ABCD."**
